Printing Output

Stage 2 Demo ⏱ 12 min 📖 Glossary

Printing is your X-ray into the program: show values, test guesses, and produce friendly output. Ten minutes here pays off in every debugging session forever.

🔎 Motivating questionHow do you check what is inside a wrapped box without cracking open your program’s skull?

Objectives

  • Use println vs print
  • Print text and numbers
  • Format simple lines

Needs first: Your First Java Program

1 Start with an analogy

Real life first, code second.

A label printer. println prints a label and feeds a fresh line; print stays on the same line; printf fills in a form with blanks (“name: ___, age: ___”) so numbers line up.

⚠️ Where the analogy breaksWhere it breaks: label printers use ink, fonts, and colors. println speaks plain text only — no colors, no bold, no layout beyond characters and line breaks.

2 The concept, plainly

One idea at a time, words before jargon.

println prints then moves to a new line. print stays on the current line. Combine them to build exact layouts.

Text goes in double quotes; numbers stand bare. The + operator joins pieces left to right — and the moment one side is a String, everything becomes text.

printf formats with placeholders: %d integers, %f decimals (%.2f = two places), %s text, %n newline. It does NOT auto-break lines — end with %n.

Evaluation order bites: "Age: " + 18 + 2 makes "Age: 182" (text from the first +), while "Age: " + (18 + 2) makes "Age: 20". Brackets first, always.

⚙️ Tech details — precise facts
  • System.out is the standard output stream; println/print/printf are methods on a PrintStream object. Errors go to System.err instead.
  • %.2f rounds (2.555 → 2.56); %d with a double crashes (use %f); %% prints a literal percent sign.
  • %n is the portable newline (Windows vs Linux differ); avoid hard-coding \n in printf.

3 Watch it move: Print heads

Step at your pace. Text explains every move.

4 Live code demo

Small, correct Java 17 (LTS) code. Read, trace, copy.

Main.javaJava 17
public class Main {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    System.out.println("Apples: " + 3);
    System.out.print("Total: ");
    System.out.println(3 * 2);
    System.out.printf("Price: $%.2f%n", 2.5);
    System.out.printf("%s is %d years old%n", "Ada", 18);
  }
}
▶ Output Apples: 3 Total: 6 Price: $2.50 Ada is 18 years old
  • Line 3 joins text + number into “Apples: 3”.
  • Lines 4–5 share one line: “Total: 6”.
  • Line 6 formats 2.5 as $2.50; line 7 mixes %s and %d.
▶️ Run it yourselfSave exactly as Main.java, then javac Main.java and java Main. Every full program in this course works this way.
💡 Why this output?“+” with a String builds text. 3*2 computes to 6 on the still-open print line. printf fills each placeholder in order and rounds 2.5 to two decimals.

6 Common mistakes (at least 3)

Wrong, why, fixed — learn from realistic slips.

❌ Mistake 1: println("3 + 2") and expecting 5.Why: Quotes mean literal text — the computer prints exactly what is inside.
✅ Fix: Drop the quotes to compute: println(3 + 2); // 5
❌ Mistake 2: Forgetting the + between pieces: println("Apples: " 3).Why: Java cannot glue by placing things side by side.
✅ Fix: "Apples: " + 3 — the plus is the glue.
❌ Mistake 3: printf with no %n, then wondering why the next output sticks.Why: printf never breaks the line by itself.
✅ Fix: End every printf format with %n.
❌ Mistake 4: "Age: " + 18 + 2 giving “Age: 182”.Why: Left-to-right: ("Age: " + 18) is text, then + 2 glues more text.
✅ Fix: "Age: " + (18 + 2) — brackets compute first.

7 Guided practice

Hints first, solutions only after a real try.

Predict it

What prints? System.out.print("A"); System.out.println("B"); System.out.println("C");

Hintprint stays, println breaks.
SolutionAB on line one, then C on line two.
Format money

Print the value 19.9 as $19.90 using printf.

Hint%.2f plus %n.
SolutionSystem.out.printf("$%.2f%n", 19.9);
Fix the age line

Fix so it prints “Age: 20”: System.out.println("Age: " + 18 + 2);

HintBrackets.
SolutionSystem.out.println("Age: " + (18 + 2));

8 Lesson quiz

3+ questions. Attempts saved locally; review queue learns your weak spots.

9 Takeaways + next step

  • println breaks the line; print does not.
  • Plus joins text left-to-right; brackets compute first.
  • printf formats with %d, %.2f, %s — end with %n.
🧠 Recall challengeWhen would you deliberately pick print over println?
